Evolution, DiffApplier, sealed-packet proof, agent-runner, and other production callers remain outside this packet and must not be edited or described as re-armed.

CLAUDE.md and docs/governance/SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md may change only through scripts/governance/render_active_track_includes.py; their managed blocks are projections of ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml, not independent policy edits.
